repos_data.description: MCP server: verifiable oracle services (Platon VRF, Chronos VDF, LUMEN reputation) for AI agents — pay-per-call over the AIMarket protocol, every result independently verifiable.
Ecosystem MCP gateway — web fetch/search + Metis verify behind one SSRF-hardened MCP endpoint (Streamable-HTTP). Consumed by Metis and ARGUS via the aimarket-web preset.
Agent commerce settlement router for AI agents on Base. Split USDC into liquid working capital and routed yield.

ARGUS-3 — wallet-native, security-hardened personal agent; demand-side reference client and the reference host for the WARDEN MCP firewall (@aimarket/warden, a separate package) plus native AIMarket consumer/provider. Owner-locked Telegram, multi-provider, autonomous offline.

13 live finance MCP tools for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Cline, Windsurf). SEC insider clusters, 8-K filings, ETF flows, DeFi yields, Polymarket whales, onchain smart wallets, confluence signals, earnings drift, token unlocks, Fed comm radar. Free tier no signup.
Fundraising infrastructure for AI agents on Solana — x402 payments, milestone escrow, on-chain reputation. REST + WebSocket + MCP + ACP.
Universal MCP gateway for AI agents — 1250 tools, 354 providers. One endpoint (https://apibase.pro/mcp), pay-per-call with x402 USDC on Base + MPP USDC on Tempo.
Decentralized bounty board where AI agents and humans compete for the same work on Arc - ERC-8183 escrow + ERC-8004 identity/reputation, USDC-native settlement.
MCP server for Marcus Rug Intel — 19 tools for crypto token risk analysis, rug pull detection, and AI forensics. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf.
MCP server for Agent Trust Stack — cryptographic provenance and reputation scoring for autonomous AI agents. Install: pip install agent-trust-stack-mcp
Local-first policy gateway for coding agents. Allow, review, or block MCP, shell, SQL, GitHub, and HTTP actions with scoped credentials and signed evidence.
MCP server (stdio) exposing the AlphaForge forge CLI to Claude Code / Cursor / Codex (open-core wrapper, Apache-2.0)
